title: Validated Settings with Descriptors
instructions: In `fields.py` implement the `Field` data descriptor (name recorded in `__set_name__`, per-instance storage in `obj.__dict__`, class access returns the descriptor, `__delete__`) and the `validate` methods of `BoundedFloat`, `BoundedInt` and `OneOf`. Errors are `ValidationError`s that name the attribute and the bad value. `CompletionSettings` is already declared with your fields.

evidence.label: Stores valid values per instance in the instance __dict__
An int temperature is coerced to float
Out-of-range, wrong-type, bool and unknown-choice values raise ValidationError naming the field
A data descriptor takes precedence over the instance dict and still validates writes
Class access returns the descriptor, which knows its attribute name
Deleting removes the value; reading or deleting an unset value raises AttributeError
Error messages include the field name and the offending value
Bounds are inclusive; strings, None, lists and bools are rejected
